best_for: People who join calls their clients, school or employer already run on Zoom, and small teams deciding whether 40 minutes per meeting is enough.
description:
Zoom Workplace is the desktop app from Zoom, the video meeting company. It is proprietary software that is free to download, and it now bundles many of Zoom's work tools into one window, with an AI assistant called ZoomMate built in.

Besides joining and hosting meetings, you can read your email and calendar in the same app, and share a Scheduler link so people can book time with you. Docs gives your team shared online documents, and Clips lets you record a short video with your screen to send instead of setting up another meeting. Your recordings sit in one library. The AI can summarize a meeting and turn what was said into tasks, docs or whiteboards. More apps for the meeting window come from the Zoom Marketplace.

points.title: Free meetings stop at 40 minutes
points.text: The free Basic plan caps meetings at 40 minutes and 100 participants, with 3 AI meeting summaries a month.

points.title: What Pro costs
points.text: Pro is listed at USD 14.16 per user per month billed yearly, or USD 16.99 billed monthly. It raises meetings to 30 hours, adds 10 GB of cloud recording per user and unlimited AI summaries. Business is USD 18.33 or 21.99. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Older systems were dropped
points.text: Current versions need Windows 10 or 11 (not S Mode) or macOS 10.15 and later. Version 6.7.7 was the last for macOS 10.13 and 10.14, and 5.17.11 the last for Windows 7 and 8.

points.title: Linux: Zoom's own packages
points.text: Zoom publishes DEB and RPM packages for Ubuntu 20.04+, Debian 11+, Fedora, RHEL 9 and others. The Flatpak listed here is a Flathub build that Flathub does not mark as verified, x64 only.

points.title: MSI for IT, x64 and Arm
points.text: The Windows installers here are machine-wide MSIs for x64 and Arm64, suited to managed rollouts. The Windows listing keeps 155 versions; macOS (Intel and Apple silicon) and Linux list only the current release.

points.title: More than video calls
points.text: The app is now Zoom Workplace, which puts team chat, whiteboards and Zoom Phone next to meetings. Zoom advises against its old 32-bit Windows app if you want all of these.
